title: Feedback-Driven Evolutionary Optimization for Stable and Efficient Fault Identification (AHD-SHGA)
description: Official replication package and implementation of the AHD-SHGA framework (Adaptive Hyper-Diversity Surrogate-Assisted Hybrid Genetic Algorithm). Includes the core feedback controller, RBF Gaussian Process surrogate, 13 comparative metaheuristic algorithms, continuous CEC 2017 and Rastrigin benchmarks, DeathStarBench distributed trace fault localization, and pre-trained checkpoints with multi-run statistical evaluation.
